note: Kali 2026.1-specific manifest. Optimized for the 2025.4 base plus the 2026.1 tool additions. Many tools come preinstalled, so the bootstrap mainly handles non-preinstalled tools and MCP registration.
kaliNewTools2026_1: adaptixc2 — post-exploitation and adversary-emulation framework (apt install adaptixc2)
atomic-operator — Atomic Red Team test runner (apt install atomic-operator)
fluxion — WiFi social-engineering audit tool (apt install fluxion)
gef — GDB Enhanced Features debug framework (apt install gef)
metasploitmcp — Metasploit MCP Server (apt install metasploitmcp)
sstimap — SSTI automated detection tool (apt install sstimap)
wpprobe — WordPress plugin enumeration (apt install wpprobe)
xsstrike — advanced XSS scanner (apt install xsstrike)
kaliNewTools2025_4: bpf-linker — BPF static linker (apt install bpf-linker)
evil-winrm-py — Python WinRM remote execution (apt install evil-winrm-py)
hexstrike-ai — AI MCP security automation platform (apt install hexstrike-ai)
kaliNativeMCP: mcp-kali-server — official Kali MCP server, connects AI to the Kali terminal (apt install mcp-kali-server, port 5000)
metasploitmcp — Metasploit MCP Server (apt install metasploitmcp, port 8085)
hexstrike-ai — MCP automation for 150+ security tools (apt install hexstrike-ai)

capabilities.name: jadx
capabilities.kaliNote: Not preinstalled on Kali. Download from GitHub Releases

capabilities.name: apktool
capabilities.kaliNote: apt install apktool is enough. If the version is old, download the latest from GitHub

capabilities.name: frida
capabilities.kaliNote: pip3 install frida-tools or apt install python3-frida-tools

capabilities.name: idalib-mcp
postInstallSteps: Restart IDA Pro so the plugin takes effect
After IDA opens a file, the MCP server listens on 127.0.0.1:13337 automatically
capabilities.kaliNote: Requires IDA Pro for Linux

capabilities.name: jeb-pro
capabilities.manualInstallHint: JEB Pro is commercial. Obtain a valid license from PNF Software, install it manually, then refresh the tool index. Optional community MCP bridges must pass the skill-supply-chain review before registration.
capabilities.kaliNote: JEB Pro Linux edition requires a user-provided license and manual installation.

capabilities.name: binaryninja
capabilities.manualInstallHint: Binary Ninja is commercial software. Obtain a valid Vector 35 license and install it manually. Optional community MCP plugins require supply-chain review and loopback binding.
capabilities.kaliNote: Binary Ninja Linux requires a user-provided license and manual installation.

capabilities.name: reqable-mcp
capabilities.kaliNote: Requires the separately installed Reqable desktop application and its local API.

capabilities.name: xquik-mcp
capabilities.note: Registers the first-party remote MCP URL only. OAuth is completed in the MCP client. No local package, bridge, or credential is installed.

capabilities.name: idapro
capabilities.portNote: Ports increment when multiple IDA instances run (13337→13338→...). Check the IDA Output window for [MCP] port=xxxxx log lines
capabilities.kaliNote: Requires IDA Pro for Linux, installed under /opt/idapro/

capabilities.name: r2
capabilities.kaliNote: Preinstalled on Kali. For the latest version, download the .deb from GitHub

capabilities.name: rabin2
capabilities.kaliNote: Installs together with radare2

capabilities.name: adb
capabilities.kaliNote: apt install adb

capabilities.name: ghidra-mcp
postInstallSteps: Install community MCP bridges only after the skill-supply-chain review
Confirm the MCP port from tool-index; do not assume a default

capabilities.name: seclists

capabilities.name: pentestswarm

capabilities.name: coercer

capabilities.name: binwalk

capabilities.name: yara
capabilities.kaliNote: Malware rule-matching engine. Preinstalled on Kali, updatable through apt.

capabilities.name: pwntools
capabilities.kaliNote: CTF pwn exploit development framework. Preinstalled on Kali, updatable through pip.

capabilities.name: bkcrack
capabilities.kaliNote: Classic ZipCrypto known-plaintext attack tool. Kali/Debian can install it through apt.

capabilities.name: redress
capabilities.kaliNote: Go stripped-binary toolkit (AGPL-3.0). Download the official release tarball; do not vendor sources.

capabilities.name: goresym

capabilities.name: capa
capabilities.kaliNote: Malware capability detection. Unzip the capa Linux build into $HOME/tools/capa.

capabilities.name: yara-x
capabilities.kaliNote: Current YARA engine (yr CLI). New rules use yr; existing .yar still run on classic yara.

capabilities.name: unblob
capabilities.kaliNote: Firmware extraction fallback (pip). Pair with binwalk.

capabilities.name: wabt
capabilities.kaliNote: Kali installs wabt through apt (distro build; apt reported 1.0.36+dfsg+~cs1.0.36-2ubuntu1 on the surveyed host). Upstream is 1.0.42 with wasm-objdump/wasm2wat/wasm2c; wasm-decompile was removed upstream in 1.0.42, so its presence follows the distro build.

capabilities.name: objection
capabilities.kaliNote: Mobile runtime exploration (pip). Pair with frida-tools 14.10.4.
